reconstruction.input_layout: Populate separate bulk-run and impurity-run directories from inputs/bulk.* and inputs/impurity.* respectively; use the packaged capture donor and terminator files as A42_SWAP_FILE/A42_TERM_FILE for cross-swap runs. Preserve the packaged input.nml routes (both recur=block) and the production FP32 runtime branch; the instrumentation stops before any potential update.
reconstruction.note: Set ASSET to the repository path docs/validation/fixed_ldau/rs/C4_A42_assets; executable/full source tree excluded. The packaged *_out.nml files are iteration-1 lineage snapshots, not the seed potential loaded by the no-update replay.
run_commands: for f in clust mad.mat str.out ves.out map; do gzip -dc "$ASSET/inputs/bulk.$f.gz" > "$f"; done
cp "$ASSET/inputs/impurity.input.nml" input.nml && cp "$ASSET/inputs/impurity.Fe-bulk.nml" Fe-bulk.nml && cp "$ASSET/inputs/impurity.Fe-imp.nml" Fe-imp.nml
for f in clust str.out map; do gzip -dc "$ASSET/inputs/impurity.$f.gz" > "$f"; done
reconstruction.swap_environment: For swaps, set RSLMTO_A42_SWAP_FILE and RSLMTO_A42_TERM_FILE to the other context captures/{bulk,impurity}.A_exactB.dat.gz and *.terminator.dat.gz after decompressing to text files; set RSLMTO_A42_STOP_AFTER_DOS=1 and RSLMTO_A42_POUT_FILE to a fresh output path.
